csv_project_name: Design Engineering for Pulaski Rd– 159th St to 149th St Proj
csv_scope_of_work: This Request for Statements of Interest (RSI) is step one of a two-step qualification selection process in determining the most qualified consultant ( Consultant ) for the award of the contract. For Step two, Cook County will issue a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) to the shortlisted firms that have responded to the RSI. The Cook County Department of Transportation and Highways is requesting SOIs, in providing project specific Consultant Services to perform Design Engineering Services for the Pulaski Road 149th Street to 159th Street project. This project will include the detailed (Phase II) design of a corridor project along Pulaski Road from north of 159th Street to 149th Street (north of the Metra Rock Island District railroad tracks). The scope includes full depth reconstruction of the 4-lane roadway with center median / left turn lanes, along with new curb and gutter, enhanced storm sewers, and sidewalks/shared-use path along the project limits. Traffic signal replacement/modernization at the 152nd Street intersection is required, along with ADA improvements. Other improvements along this section of Pulaski Road include railroad grade crossing safety improvements along with rehabilitation of the bridge over Midlothian Creek. Additionally, Phase II design services anticipate new topographic survey, utility coordination, Forest Preserve District of Cook County and Metra railroad coordination, preparation of plats and legal documents for property acquisition, agreements, permits, and drainage design; in addition to typical plans specifications and estimates development.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Sanitation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
